post.description:
Durably admit authorized V3 work and return 202 with its log ID.

The staging record and dispatch receipt precede cold-path processing.
A separate worker or the combined runtime consumes that work outside
the request handler. Admission latency depends on storage and queue
state; acknowledgement does not prove processing completion.

get.summary: Query cold-path processing status for a raw_log entry
get.description:
Return the current processing status of a queued raw_log entry.

Used by the evaluation harness (``recall_harness.py``) to poll for
cold-path completion instead of relying on fragile time-based
heuristics.

Terminal states: ``processed``, ``failed``, ``rejected``.

200.description: Current processing status of the log entry

schema.title: Response Get Status V3 Memory Status  Log Id  Get

post.description:
Execute a hybrid memory search via the production HybridRetriever.

Performs ranked retrieval through the full fusion pipeline:
  1. Vector similarity (LanceDB) — cosine distance scoring.
  2. Lexical pre-filter (FTS5) — BM25-normalised scoring.
  3. Graph traversal (KùzuDB) — cognitive salience scoring.
  4. Reciprocal-rank fusion of available lane rankings, with optional
     legacy CrossEncoder reranking when configured.

Results are returned in the canonical response schema:
``{context, retrieved_nodes, metrics, degraded_sources}``.

get.summary: Retrieve one memory record within an agent and session scope
get.description:
Return one scoped node or durable raw record without leaking other scopes.

``raw_<log_id>`` is the stable identifier returned by the MCP store
tool while asynchronous ingestion is still processing the record.

schema.title: Response Get Memory Record V3 Memory Records  Memory Id  Get

delete.description:
Soft-delete memory records by agent or session scope.

**CRITICAL**: This endpoint creates a durable SQLite purge journal
and tombstone before any downstream action. It MUST NOT trigger VACUUM
or compaction. Journal-recorded Kuzu/vector deletes are idempotent,
verified steps; a partial failure returns retry-pending rather than
reporting purge success.

200.description: Purge result with affected record count

schema.title: Response Purge Memory V3 Memory Purge Delete

MemoryInsertRequest.title: MemoryInsertRequest
MemoryInsertRequest.description:
Schema for memory ingestion payloads.

Validates that all identity fields are non-empty, non-reserved,
and that content does not exceed the 32 KB size limit.

Fields:
    agent_id: Tenant identifier for row-level isolation (1-128 chars).
    session_id: Session scope within the agent (1-128 chars).
    content: Text content to store (1 to 32,768 characters).
    metadata: Optional key-value metadata (max 64 keys, no nesting).

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Purge scope: 'agent' for all data, 'session' for a single session

scope_id.title: Scope Id
scope_id.description: Target identifier to purge (agent_id or session_id)

MemoryPurgeRequest.title: MemoryPurgeRequest
MemoryPurgeRequest.description:
Schema for memory purge (soft-delete) payloads.

Purge requests ONLY trigger soft-deletes at the API layer.
Physical removal is handled by the isolated MaintenanceWorker.

Fields:
    agent_id: Tenant identifier of the requester (1-128 chars).
    scope: Purge scope — 'agent' (all data) or 'session' (single session).
    scope_id: Target identifier to purge (the agent_id or session_id).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session scope within the agent tenant

temporal_filter.title: Temporal Filter
temporal_filter.description: Optional dict with 'valid_from', 'valid_to', or 'valid_at' ISO-8601 strings

MemorySearchRequest.title: MemorySearchRequest
MemorySearchRequest.description:
Schema for memory search/query payloads.

Validates identity fields, query string bounds, and enforces
a hard ceiling on search result limits.

Fields:
    agent_id: Tenant identifier for row-level isolation (1-128 chars).
    session_id: Session scope within the agent (1-128 chars).
    query: Search query string (1 to 4,096 characters).
    limit: Maximum results to return (1-50, default 10).
